sources_considered.why: The original disclosure describes both scene-consistency capabilities and failures, but supplies no decisive study of internal representations.
The acknowledged failures do not establish complete absence of scene-wide representations or quantify local correctness across the relevant sample.
The review describes its basis as public reports and reverse engineering; its abstract does not establish the claimed absence of representations.
A targeted read for object permanence returned no matching passage.

evidence_items.explanation: The section describes coherent movement through space; the following section reports some persistence through occlusion and across shots. These reported successes challenge an inference of complete absence from failures, but do not directly establish internal comprehension.

unresolved_gaps: No retrieved study directly establishes the presence or absence of the relevant internal representations in the original Sora model.
The post does not identify a complete sample of faulty clips for evaluating most or all.
No systematic patch-level assessment establishes virtually universal local correctness.
The evidence does not distinguish absent representations from representations that work inconsistently.
